headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty snapped two-week gains as surging crude oil prices hit market sentiment.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 26 October.

why: Crude oil prices surged to $117 per barrel, dragging down market sentiment
Profit booking occurred after the market reached recent highs over a two-week period
Concerns over global economic growth and rising energy costs
Selling pressure in major stocks like Adani Enterprises during the weekly wrap
whatHappening: AU Small Finance Bank reported a 53% increase in Q2 profit to Rs 858 crore
JK Cement's revenue grew by 23.7% while profit rose to ₹169 crore
Tata Motors is leveraging a 20% revenue cushion against potential downturns in commercial vehicles
Nifty 50 ended the last session at 22,600 while Sensex fell 125 points
summary: On the last trading day, Indian markets snapped a two-week winning streak as Sensex and Nifty fell amid surging crude oil prices. Despite the broader market decline, AU Small Finance Bank and JK Cement reported strong quarterly earnings growth. The market is currently closed for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 26 October.
